        int n = Integer.parseInt(input.readLine().trim());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(input.readLine().trim());

        intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;

        dp[1] = new SegmentTree(n);

                data[j] = Math.min(data[j], minNeed + 2);
            }

            cur.fromArray(data);
        }

        int result = dp[k & 1].query(n, n);
        if (result < INF) {
            output.println("Full");
            output.println(result);
        } else {
            output.println("Hungry");
        }

    static class SegmentTree {
        int n;
        int[] tree;
        int[] lazy;
        boolean[] lazyFlag;

        SegmentTree(int size) {
            n = size;
            tree = new int[4 * (n + 1)];
            lazy = new int[4 * (n + 1)];
            lazyFlag = new boolean[4 * (n + 1)];
            Arrays.fill(tree, INF);
        }

        void build(int node, int l, int r) {
            if (l == r) {
                tree[node] = (l == 0) ? 0 : INF;
                return;
            }
            int mid = (l + r) / 2;
            build(node * 2, l, mid);
            build(node * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r);
            tree[node] = Math.min(tree[node * 2], tree[node * 2 + 1]);
        }

        void pushDown(int node, int l, int r) {
            if (lazyFlag[node]) {
                tree[node * 2] = lazy[node];
                tree[node * 2 + 1] = lazy[node];
                lazy[node * 2] = lazy[node];
                lazy[node * 2 + 1] = lazy[node];
                lazyFlag[node * 2] = true;
                lazyFlag[node * 2 + 1] = true;
                lazyFlag[node] = false;
            }
        }

        void updateRange(int node, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int val) {
            if (ql > r || qr < l) return;
            if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
                tree[node] = val;
                lazy[node] = val;
                lazyFlag[node] = true;
                return;
            }
            pushDown(node, l, r);
            int mid = (l + r) / 2;
            updateRange(node * 2, l, mid, ql, qr, val);
            updateRange(node * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, ql, qr, val);
            tree[node] = Math.min(tree[node * 2], tree[node * 2 + 1]);
        }

        int queryRange(int node, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
            if (ql > r || qr < l) return INF;
            if (ql <= l && r <= qr) return tree[node];
            pushDown(node, l, r);
            int mid = (l + r) / 2;
            return Math.min(queryRange(node * 2, l, mid, ql, qr),
                           queryRange(node * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, ql, qr));
        }

        void toArray(int[] arr) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                arr[i] = queryRange(1, 0, n, i, i);
            }
        }

        void fromArray(int[] arr) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                updateRange(1, 0, n, i, i, arr[i]);
            }
        }

        int query(int l, int r) {
